hypotheses.justification: `hθ₀ : θ₀ ∈ Icc a b` already gives `a ≤ b`. So if `a < b` fails, then `a = b`. In that case `Ioo a a = ∅`, so `circleMap ζ ρ '' Ioo a b = ∅` (`Set.image_empty`). The filter is then `𝓝[∅] (circleMap ζ ρ θ₀) = ⊥` (Mathlib `nhdsWithin_empty`), and `Tendsto f ⊥ (𝓝 v)` holds for any `v` (Mathlib `tendsto_bot`), e.g. `v = 0`. The proof without `hab`: split with `rcases hθ₀.1.lt_or_eq`. When `a < b`, run the existing proof (the only places it uses `hab` are `circleMap_mem_closure_image_Ioo` and `subsingleton_clusterSetOn_circleMap_image_Ioo`). When `a = b`, take `⟨0, by simp [nhdsWithin_empty, tendsto_bot]⟩` after rewriting `Ioo_self` / `image_empty`. Every other hypothesis is genuinely needed. `hab2π` is needed: with `b - a = 2π` and `f` a branch of `log` on the unit circle minus one point, the one-sided limits at the endpoint differ. `hUo` is needed: on a non-open `U` such as the arc itself, `deriv f` can be the junk value 0, which makes `hfin` vacuous while `f` oscillates along the arc.
